Connor —

We just ran a targeted export for Avalon AI (deal 8743) and I see six distinct promo/top-up requests over the last 10 days that tie back to the same billing domain but different team aliases (dev-team, analytics-pilot, growthlab, etc.). Hi Marissa and Connor,

Thanks for the heads up — fair concern. Quick context from our side: Avalon ran a company-wide exploration week last month where multiple product squads spun up small demo projects. Each squad asked for individual sandbox credits so they could run short PoCs with different datasets. There was a central internal coordinator (me) who requested credits on behalf of the squads and then redistributed credentials to the team leads.

I realize that looks like "credential handoff" in your logs. This was intended to be internal and temporary; we did not realize it might trigger your fraud detection. Apologies for the noise.

We can provide a short attestation (email from our CTO) confirming the internal pilot, or we can consolidate remaining requests under a single sandbox account if that helps your policy review. Let me know what evidence you need.

Best,
Darya Ivanova
Product Operations Manager
Avalon AI

That aligns with Darya's note about central redistribution. No payment fraud indicators; nothing showing malicious scripted signups.

Given Darya's offer to provide a CTO attestation and the fact there are legitimate product teams involved, my recommendation:
- Lift the temporary hold on existing credits that are already active (no refunds)
- Freeze any new manual promo grants for Avalon for 7 days while they either: (a) consolidate requests under a single sandbox OR (b) provide an internal attestation AND a concise lead list showing intended teams/users
- Flag the account for monitoring for 30 days and set a soft quota for new credits

Marissa — if you're comfortable, send a 1-paragraph ask to the customer (sample language below) and I'll keep monitoring logs.

Sample ask to send to Avalon: "Thanks Darya — to accelerate lifting holds we need a short attestation from your CTO confirming these are internal pilots and a list of the team leads who should receive ongoing credits. Once we have that we'll re-enable manual grants under a controlled quota."
